ch.SystemMessageFirstLogin: 新人？第一次报道？好吧，拿着，这是你今天的补给，每天都能领一份，但是至少得间隔24小时，这儿，拿走就行。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithNewYear: 新年快乐啊大兵，今天可不是个报道的好日子，知道吗？看你那样子我猜你肯定知道，这是你的补给，新春贺岁版，每天你都能领一份补给，但至少要隔24小时，拿着吧。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithChristmas: 圣诞快乐，雇佣兵，第一次报道？那你运气不错，这是你的补给，今天圣诞节，平常可没有这么多好东西，你可以每天领一份补给，但是至少得等24小时才能领明天的。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithMothersDay: 这个日子来报道？今天是母亲节，大兵，你最好待在家里陪你妈妈，而不是在这儿待着。既然来了，领走今天的补给吧，母亲节限定。补给每天都有，但得等24小时才有新的。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithHalloween: 不给糖就捣蛋！嘿放轻松，只是开个玩笑，今天万圣节，这是你的糖果。好吧其实不止糖果，但是里面也包括糖果。你每天都能领一份补给，但是两次之间至少要间隔24小时。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithThxgvngDay: 来报道？今天可是个好日子，虽然没有火鸡，但是你可以领一份补给，感恩节专属的。从现在起每24小时你都可以领一份新的补给，记住是24小时。
ch.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithValentine: 情人节来报道？今天没有约会？好吧，我猜肯定没有，不然你也不会在这儿了。拿着，情人节限定补给，里面有巧克力。你每天都可以领到一份补给，但是至少得间隔24小时。
ch.SystemMessageDaily1: 你好啊小蛇，这是你今天的补给。
ch.SystemMessageDaily2: 嘿雇佣兵，这是你今日份的补给，来吧拿着，免费的。
ch.SystemMessageDaily3: 大兵，这是你今天的补给，省着点儿用！
ch.SystemMessageDaily4: 这是你今日份的补给，拿好了。
ch.SystemMessageDaily5: 今天如何？这是你今天的补给，拿着吧。
ch.SystemMessageDaily6: 每天运动，健康长寿。开玩笑的，我是金属制品。拿走你的补给吧。
ch.SystemMessageDaily7: 这是你今日份的补给，这些东西就没有用完的一天吗？
ch.SystemMessageDaily8: 你的每日补给，抓住机会，别错过了。
ch.SystemMessageDaily9: 来吧大兵，领走你今天的补给。
ch.SystemMessageDaily10: 今日份的补给还在等你，别白白浪费了。
ch.SystemMessageDaily11: 休息一下，拿上你的补给，你应得的。
ch.SystemMessageDaily12: 好了起来，领走你的补给，你会需要它的。
ch.SystemMessageDaily13: 花点时间领走你的每日补给，放松一下心情。
ch.SystemMessageDaily14: 今日份补给送达，可别错过了。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly1: 已经一周了？好，好，这是你的补给，好好干，伙计。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly2: 时间过得真快，不是吗？又一个星期过去了，是时候做正事了。这是你的补给，好钢用在刀刃上。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly3: 举杯吧，敬这充实的一周，你的补给在这。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly4: 已经一个星期了？继续努力。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly5: 哇喔，七天时间一眨眼就过去了！专注，计划，战斗。
ch.SystemMessageWeekly6: 日子过得真快，不是吗？这是你的补给，继续发光发热吧。
ch.SystemMessageMonthly1: 日子过得真快啊，也许你该给自己批个假。
ch.SystemMessageMonthly2: 一个月了？继续努力，这是你应得的。
ch.SystemMessageMonthly3: 又一个月了？也许我该给你颁个奖什么的…可惜我没有，拿走你的补给吧。
ch.SystemMessageMonthly4: 又是一个月？干活的时候时间过得总是很快。
ch.SystemMessageMonthly5: 一个月的努力应得的回报，继续保持。
ch.SystemMessageNewYear: 新年快乐！这是你的红包。
ch.SystemMessageMothersDay: 今天是母亲节，别忘了陪陪你的妈妈。
ch.SystemMessageHalloween: 不给糖就捣蛋？好吧我当然会给，这是你的糖果。
ch.SystemMessageThxgvngDay: 很抱歉我们不提供火鸡…但是有这个。
ch.SystemMessageValentine: 今天没有约会？听起来真不幸啊，别灰心了，来吃点巧克力吧。
ch.SystemMessageDebug: 这是一条Debug邮件，理论上你应该看不到这行字。

en.SystemMessageFirstLogin: First time to report? This is your ration, you can get one every day, at lest 24 hours apart, take it.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithNewYear: Happy New Year soldier, Today is not a good day to report you know? You must know I guess. This is your ration, new year version, you can get one ration every day, at lest 24 hours apart, take it.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithChristmas: Merry Christmas mercenary, first time to report? This is your ration, you're lucky it's Christmas, the usual rations do not have this kind of goodies. You can get one ration every day, at lest 24 hours apart, take it.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithMothersDay: Report today? Today is Mother's Day soldier, you should better go spend time with your mother, and not on here.Now that you're here, take today's ration, Mother's Day only, Every day you can receive a ration, but at least 24 hours apart.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithHalloween: Trick or treat! Oh, be relax just a kidding, today is Halloween, that's your candy, not actually all candy, but include candy. You can get one ration every day, at lest 24 hours apart.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithThxgvngDay: Coming to report today? It's a good day. We don't have a turkey but you can get a ration, exclusive to Thanksgiving Day. From now on you can get a ration every 24 hours, remember 24hours.
en.SystemMessageFirstLoginWithValentine: Valentine's Day to report? No date today huh? Well, I guess not, or you wouldn't be here. Come on and get your Valentine's Day ration, there is chocolate inside. You can get retion everyday, but need at lest 24 hours apart.
en.SystemMessageDaily1: Hello little viper, that's your ration today.
en.SystemMessageDaily2: Hey mercenary, that's your ration today, come on take it.
en.SystemMessageDaily5: How is it going today? Your ration here, take it.
en.SystemMessageDaily6: Exercise every day, health and longevity. Just kidding, I am a metal product. Come on, take your ration.
en.SystemMessageDaily7: This is your ration today, Geez, can't we ever run out of this stuff?
en.SystemMessageDaily8: Your daily ration is here, make sure to grab it.
en.SystemMessageDaily9: Come on soldier, it's time to collect your ration.
en.SystemMessageDaily10: Today's ration is waiting for you, don't let it go to waste.
en.SystemMessageDaily11: Take a break and grab your ration, you've earned it.
en.SystemMessageDaily12: Step up and claim your ration, you'll need it for the day ahead.
en.SystemMessageDaily13: Take a moment to grab your ration, you'll be glad you did.
en.SystemMessageDaily14: The rations for the day are now available, don't miss out.
en.SystemMessageWeekly1: It's been a week? Well, well, here's your ration, do it right, man.
en.SystemMessageWeekly2: Time flies, doesn't it? Another week has passed and it's time to get down to business. Here's your share, make the most of it.
en.SystemMessageWeekly3: Here's to another productive week. Let's make it count.
en.SystemMessageWeekly4: A week already? Keep up the good work.
en.SystemMessageWeekly5: Wow, seven days have gone by in a blink of an eye. Stay focused and stay motivated.
en.SystemMessageWeekly6: The days are passing quickly, aren't they? Here's your rations, make it count.
en.SystemMessageMonthly1: The days are passing quickly, maybe you should give yourself a break.
en.SystemMessageMonthly2: A month now? Keep it up, you've earned it.
en.SystemMessageMonthly3: Another month? Maybe I should give you an award or something....Unfortunately I don't have one, now take your rations out.
en.SystemMessageMonthly4: Another month already? Time flies when you're working hard.
en.SystemMessageMonthly5: A month of hard work has paid off. Keep going strong.
en.SystemMessageNewYear: Happy New Year! This is your gift.
en.SystemMessageChristmas: Merry Christmas! This is your gift, come on take it.
en.SystemMessageMothersDay: Today is Mother's Day, remember to spend some time with your mother, child.
en.SystemMessageHalloween: Trick or treat? Of course treat, that's your candy.
en.SystemMessageThxgvngDay: Sorry we don't have trucks...but we have this.
en.SystemMessageValentine: No date today? Don't be discouraged, have some chocolate.
